graph-axes.def: The labels on a graph's axes: the quantity and its unit, such as "Time (s)". The independent variable (the one you choose or control) usually goes on the horizontal axis.

slope.def: The steepness of a line: rise over run, Δy/Δx between two points on the line. Its unit is (y unit)/(x unit), and it tells you the rate at which y changes with x.

linear-relationship.def: A relationship whose graph is a straight line, y = mx + b, with slope m and vertical intercept b.

area-under-graph.def: The area between a graph and the horizontal axis over an interval. Its unit is (y unit) × (x unit); area below the axis counts as negative.

best-fit-line.def: A straight line drawn through scattered data with about as many points above it as below. It is never drawn dot to dot; its slope uses all the data.

linearization.def: Choosing what to plot so that the graph is a straight line, for example d against t² when d = ½at², so the slope gives the quantity you want.
